raw.problem: The repaint plumbing as specified, SETTINGS_CHANGED "skin" into B:OnSettingsChanged plus B:AdoptProfile, misses several real paths. B:AdoptProfile returns at once when the History window was never built, so a profile switch, copy or reset before the window opens never calls Skin:SetChoice. The library-owned frames (settings chrome, debug console, sim/perf panels) then keep the old profile's skin. 'Copy to every Ka0s addon' run from another addon writes through LH's RegisterOwner opts.set and calls SetChoice; it never touches LH's bus, and the bus target exists only while LH is enabled. The tab's own select path calls set() and then SetChoice. If LH's set is Schema:Set with an onChange that also calls SetChoice, every click calls SetChoice twice, and eui->ka0s raises the reload popup twice. Nothing applies the saved choice after the DB loads either, because opts.get() at file load has no NS.db.

LootHistory's host repaint (window, tabs, filter bar, row menu, tab-registry reskin(), file-load markup rebuild) subscribes to the owner-scoped S.OnLooksChanged in core/SkinSetup.lua, not to SETTINGS_CHANGED. RegisterOwner opts.get reads NS.db.profile.appearance lazily and nil-safely (answers ka0s before InitDB). opts.set writes the profile table raw, so the library-driven copy-to-all and the tab, which call SetChoice themselves, never cause a second SetChoice. The two schema rows' onChange call Skin:SetChoice only when the stored value differs from Skin:GetChoice(owner), which covers /lh set and Defaults. Call Skin:SetChoice("LootHistory", profile.appearance.source, profile.appearance.skin) once after InitDB, and from NS.OnProfileEvent before the Browser and Schema adopts, whether or not the window exists. raw.problem: EllesmereUI.RegisterSkin is called once, at RegisterOwner time (the consumer's file load). Three things go wrong. (1) An addon that loads before EllesmereUI never registers, because the global is absent and the call is presence-guarded and skipped. The EUI choice is then permanently unavailable even though the gate reads open. (2) RegisterSkin dedups by name and the first callback wins forever. A closure that captures one minor's file-local functions keeps running that stale code after a newer LibKa0s minor loads. (3) The gate (loaded, master on, entry on) can hold while no facade ever arrived, for example after a late registration or a callback that raised, so the tab offers an EUI choice that silently paints nothing.
raw.evidence: EllesmereUI_SharedHelpers.lua:59-73 (RegisterSkin returns early for a duplicate name; it queues, then _DispatchSkinRegistration). Facades are stored in lib.euiFacade[owner] (lib.x = lib.x or {}). Registration is retried for every owner not yet registered: at RegisterOwner, on ADDON_LOADED for EllesmereUI, and at PLAYER_LOGIN, through lib.SafeRegisterEvent (not a raw RegisterEvent, so the LibKa0s CLAUDE.md events-frames-taint-§1 row trigger does not fire). GetEUIStatus gains a fourth, internal condition, "EllesmereUI handed us its skin this session" (facade stored), with the hint "Reload the UI". The EUI choice is selectable only when all four hold.' (c) A frame created before the facade arrives (OnEnable can run before EUI's PLAYER_LOGIN boot handler) gets no defined handling.
